title: Automation Senior Manager, Skroutz Warehouse (ASMSK 0626)
description:
At Skroutz, our mission is simple: we aim to amaze. From our humble beginnings back in 2005, we believe that happy customers equal happy merchants and it’s our job to understand and anticipate their needs and offer them an unparalleled, doubt-free experience. 

Our vision is clear: we aspire to become the Everyday App, the go-to destination where millions fulfill their online shopping needs. Whether you're looking for a new smartphone, restocking your pantry with essentials, seeking the perfect outfit for an upcoming event, or simply hunting for that collectible gaming console, Skroutz is your trusted partner for seamless shopping experiences.

And our ambitions extend far beyond Greece's borders. We're on a trajectory to become one of Europe's fastest-growing Marketplaces, with exciting expansions already underway in Cyprus and the Balkans. Our commitment to customer satisfaction remains paramount, guiding every decision we make.

To achieve our vision, we seek individuals who share our passion for e-commerce and technology. If you're driven by the desire to create extraordinary shopping moments for our users, as well as help sellers all around the world grow their businesses, then we want you on our team.

Join us at Skroutz and be part of a journey that's reshaping the way we shop online. Together, let's turn everyday moments into remarkable experiences.

Ready for the challenge?

#AimToAmaze

How will you contribute to Skroutz vision

We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Automation Senior Manager to oversee, optimize, and revolutionize our fulfillment center operations. In this role, you will hold true end-to-end ownership in the reliability of all fulfillment center processes, serving as the strategic driving force behind our operational throughput. You will bridge the gap between traditional logistics and cutting-edge technology by architecting our current automation systems, designing and implementing new automated solutions, and strategically orchestrating fulfillment center spatial layout - including shelf ordering and inventory re-allocation.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven problem solver and team leader, with a proven track record of scaling fulfillment center efficiencies, managing complex vendor relationships, and leading high-impact automation projects from conception to execution while coaching production teams directly on the field.

What you will be doing

Process Optimization & Workflow Design

  • End-to-End Ownership: We are looking for a leader that will have end-to-end ownership in the reliability of all our processes. You should have a keen eye for LEAN to analyze, map, and continuously improve all fulfillment center operational workflows (receiving, decanting, stocking, picking, packing, and sorting) to maximize throughput and minimize cycle times.
  • Standardization & Knowledge Management: You will serve as the source for standardization and setting our production goals (KPIs). Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), intricate network topology maps, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for all fulfillment center processes.
  • Lean Champion: You bring a Kaizen mentality to the field; utilize appropriate methodologies to identify bottlenecks, implementing sustainable corrective actions and delivering direct production improvements.
  • Change Management: Lead by example and inspire our production teams by coaching them on the field; oversee the testing, commissioning, and employee training for all newly introduced technologies, workflows, and process updates to ensure smooth operational transitions.

Procurement & Capacity

  • Facilities & Layout Optimisation: Act as a spatial visionary to dynamically optimize the fulfillment center layout and strategies, leveraging the wealth of data available in Skroutz..
  • Infrastructure ScalingStrategy: Drive the strategic scaling of our facilities; lead the design, specification, and procurement of storage systems ensuring a high return on our capital deployment.

Automation & Innovation

  • Current System Oversight: Challenge the status quo and serve as the strategic driving force and subject matter expert (SME) for all existing fulfillment center automation systems ( WMS, WCS , Autostore, Sorting station etc. )
  • Future-Proofing & Tech Integration: Own the automation roadmap; scout, evaluate, and business-case new automation technologies (e.g., robotic picking, vision systems, automated packaging) to scale operations and maximize ROI.
  • Integration Support: Bridge the gap between physical automation and our digital ecosystem; partner with IT and software teams to ensure seamless data flow and uptime continuity between the fulfillment center Management System (WMS) and physical automation hardware, building high-availability systems.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in managing automated fulfillment environments, logistics engineering, or scaling complex operations.
  • Evaluate and manage industrial equipment and infrastructure, identifying opportunities for technological upgrades and automation integration.
  • Partner with vendor engineering teams to deploy automated material handling equipment (MHE) and robotic solutions, managing complex SLAs.
  • Strong technical command over Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) architecture and data flow integration to perform predictive bottleneck analysis.
  • Comfortable with developing software and building hardware.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with people at all levels and attitude to maintain in the project team a culture of teamwork, driving performance, engagement and change alignment.

Benefits

What's it like to work at Skroutz?

    • A great opportunity to contribute to the evolution of Skroutz towards becoming one of Europe’s fastest growing Marketplaces
    • Thrive in an environment that champions ambitious goals, empowers autonomy, fosters mentoring, and unlocks exciting opportunities for both personal and business growth
    • Competitive full-time salary
    • Ongoing training and development
    • Access to books, online courses, and relevant resources
    • Top of the Line tools and equipment
    • Private Medical Plan
    • Hybrid Working
    • Free gym membership at Golden Gym in Athens, plus OAKA cross training & running courses, Padel and online yoga
    • For all New Skroutz Fathers we offer 30 working days paternity leave (1,5 months in total)
    • Monthly childcare allowance for all Skroutz Parents
    • Free Skroutz Plus subscription
    • Monthly gas coverage for commuting

As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, Skroutz is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard to race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, disability, sexual orientation, or religion.

title: Business Analyst-Skroutz Last Mile(BA0926)
description:
At Skroutz Last Mile, we believe that great decisions start with great insights. As we continue to scale our operations and evolve our delivery network across Greece and Cyprus, we are looking for a Business Analyst to help us turn complex business questions and data into clear, actionable insights.

You will join our Strategy & BI team, working closely with stakeholders across Operations, Product, and Finance to transform raw operational data into models, identify opportunities, and support strategic and operational decisions that drive the business forward.

What you will be doing

  • Analyse operational and financial data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports for key business metrics (KPIs)
  • Investigate operational questions end to end: define the metric, model the data correctly, validate against ground truth, and present a clear answer
  • Collaborate with the Operations team to translate operational challenges into analytical frameworks and actionable insights
  • Collaborate closely with BI team to define data requirements and data extraction
  • Translate forecasts into concrete operational plans (headcount, shifts, resourcing) for teams across the company
  • Support strategic initiatives with ad-hoc analysis and business case modelling
  • Document business processes and translate them into clear requirements for technical teams
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders

Requirements

  • 3+ years in a business / operations / strategy analyst role, ideally in logistics, supply chain, e-commerce, or another operationally intensive domain.
  • Strong spreadsheet modeling (Google Sheets and/or Excel) for planning and financial work
  • Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau or Power BI
  • Ability to own ambiguous problems end to end and present results clearly to senior stakeholders
  • Excellent communication skills — ability to convey complex findings clearly
  • Structured problem-solving mindset with high attention to detail
  • Greek and English working proficiency


Nice-to-have:

  • Experience in logistics, supply chain or operations analytics
  • Familiarity with SQL or Python 

Benefits

What's it like to work at Skroutz Last Mile

  • Competitive full-time salary (€28,000-€32,200 gross annually)
  • Working with top-notch and fun people
  • Career Development Opportunities
  • Culture of unity
  • Private Medical Plan
  • Access to vast technological features
  • Extra paid time off
  • Opportunities to grow with us
  • Free Skroutz Plus subscription

Our Values

  • Maintain a user-centric approach and a desire to amaze
  • Own it
  • Be results driven
  • See cars, not horses
  • Set big goals, take small steps and act now
  • Embrace humility, honesty and helpfulness and assume good intentions
  • Have fun

title: Business Intelligence Engineer -Skroutz Last Mile (BIE0826)
description:
At Skroutz Last Mile, data plays a central role in how we scale operations, improve customer experience and drive strategic decisions. As we continue to grow and evolve our delivery network, we are investing in the platforms, tools and people that enable smarter, faster and more impactful decision making across the organization.

We are looking for a BI Engineer to join our Strategy & BI team. This role combines data engineering and business analytics, requiring someone who is as comfortable building data pipelines and models as they are translating data into actionable business insights.

We expect you to understand the business processes behind the data and use that understanding to develop solutions that drive meaningful decisions across the organization.

You will design, build and maintain data products, pipelines and reporting solutions that support forecasting, planning, financial reporting and strategic decision-making. You will also contribute to the evolution of our data platform, improve the scalability of our analytics ecosystem and help shape next-generation analytics, automation and AI-powered workflows.

What you will be doing

  • Design, build and maintain reliable data pipelines and workflows
  • Develop and optimize SQL models, datasets and reporting layers
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions
  • Contribute to the development of a scalable data warehouse architecture
  • Maintain and enhance forecasting, planning and finance reporting solutions
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions
  • Analyze operational and business performance data to identify trends, opportunities and risks
  • Design and build AI-powered data products, automation and agentic workflows to improve business processes and decision making.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years of experience in a BI, data engineering or analytics engineering role
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with complex, large-scale datasets
  • Solid Python knowledge for data processing and automation
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience applying machine learning techniques (e.g. regression, classification or forecasting) to business problems
  • Familiarity with data warehousing concepts 
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate business problems into data solutions
  • Clear communicator — comfortable presenting technical work to non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience in logistics, supply chain or operations analytics
  • Background in forecasting, planning or financial reporting systems
  • Experience with statistics, predictive analytics or machine learning
  • Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents or workflow automation tools
  • Experience building internal tools or self-service analytics solutions
